meta.tagline: Faith, devotion, and courage stand strong against oppression in a battle for justice.
description: Set against a backdrop of deep spiritual traditions and rural life, the story follows a devoted family man whose life revolves around his loved ones and his sacred pilgrimage. Guided by strong moral values and a protective spirit, he strives to maintain peace within his community. However, when local political rivalries and arrogant forces begin targeting innocent villagers, his quiet existence is thrown into deep turmoil.

As tensions escalate, he is forced to stand up and confront those who abuse their power. Balancing his spiritual commitment with the urgent need to protect the dignity of his family, his journey becomes a fierce fight for honor and righteousness. Highlighting high-stakes conflict and intense emotional drama, he fights against all odds to uphold justice.
